thread:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — QuantumHealth ramped a 10k QPS blast during the POC earlier and started seeing 5xxs. They want a short tech note for SLA negotiation. Can SE/Eng triage?
Priya (SE): Looking now. From quick traces it looks like front-proxy queuing + worker queue saturation. Backpressure started at ~2.6k concurrent requests per GPU; tokenization spikes pushed latency which batched KV cache evictions.
Marco (Eng): Repro steps I used:
```
# ramp script
wrk -t64 -c3000 -d120s --script=prompt_ramp.lua https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Observed tail: a lot of 429 from proxy then 503 from runtime when workers dropped connections during KV reload.
Tess (SRE): If that's the pattern, we should recommend a 3-phase runbook: 1) Ramp (10m ramp to target), 2) Soak (30m), 3) Microburst tests (5 x 1m at 2.5x). Also set proxy conn pool to 200, increase keepalive, and enable prefix KV caching for predictable hot prefixes.
Sam (AE): Customer target: 95th latency <250ms at sustained 2k QPS. They asked for committed SLA vs "best-effort hosted" pricing — need numbers and mitigations to include in the contract.
Priya (SE): Ballpark infra for that SLO with current model (gpt-3x-32b-q8) + observed load: ~6 dedicated GPUs across 2 AZs with burst headroom. Estimated delta vs hosted: ~$18k/mo reserved + $0.06/token during bursts. I'll attach a detailed sheet but this is a starting point.
Marco (Eng): Quick config snippet to include in runbook:
```
route:
  model: gpt-3x-32b-q8
  concurrency_limit: 2500
  autoscale:
    min_instances: 6
    max_instances: 10
    burst_window_seconds: 60
proxy:
  conn_pool: 200
  keepalive: 90s
```
Tess (SRE): FYI we noticed small cold-start jitter tied to KMS calls for HSM keys during the last test. Enabling local KMS caching reduced that spike by ~30ms — include as mitigation.
Sam (AE): Great. Plan: Priya will draft a 1-page executive + 1-page tech appendix (root cause, config changes, runbook, cost delta). Marco/Tess to confirm the autoscale numbers and any SRE caveats. I'll get back to QuantumHealth with suggested SLA language.
Priya (SE): I'll attach perf CSVs and a short flamegraph snapshot. Also adding recommended acceptance criteria: 95th<250ms for 30m soak and no >1% 5xx.
Marco (Eng): Confirmed PVC and disk IO aren't the bottleneck; proxy CPU and tokenizer threads were the hot path. Proposed fix: move tokenization into worker preprocessor and bump proxy CPU to 4 vCPU for POC.
OpsBot: Deploy scheduled: canary proxy bump to 4vCPU at 2026-03-22T02:00Z — monitor latency/5xx for 40m.
Sam (AE): Copy that — will push summary to the customer and set up a follow-up call. Thanks :thumbsup:
